name: Pramod Mishra
description: Pramod Mishra is a Director at PwC India and co-founded its Blockchain Lab in 2017. Across 16 years in technology and nearly a decade in blockchain, he has designed Ethereum and EVM-based systems spanning CBDCs, carbon markets, land records, healthcare and humanitarian cash. His work includes initiatives involving 38 institutions and more than 750 atomic transactions. He focuses on digital infrastructure that is interoperable, verifiable and usable without losing privacy or human agency.
